description_en: Enables or disables the cluster lock
description_zh: 开启或者关闭集群保护锁
name: ModifyDBClusterDeletion

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target cluster.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to find the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
目标集群ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the cluster lock. The default value is false. Valid values:

true: Enables the cluster lock. When this feature is enabled, the cluster cannot be released. To release the cluster, first disable the cluster lock.

false: Disables the cluster lock
parameters.help_zh:
开启或者关闭集群保护锁，默认值为false，取值：

true：开启集群保护锁，开启后不能直接释放该集群，需要关闭集群保护锁后重新释放。
false：关闭集群保护锁
parameters.name: protection
